heading: Build the Parallel.

hero.title: Build the Parallel.
hero.subtitle: RFPs and {mark}Prize
hero.body:
RFPs fund your team to build a specification. {mark}Prize rewards products on Logos
that launch to real users. Choose your path.

programmes.name: RFP Programme
programmes.intro: Send a proposal to a given spec. Get funded to build it.
programmes.body:
RFPs provide funding to build and audit costly protocols, core building blocks and
infrastructure. It starts with a spec from Logos. Your team responds with a proposal
including approach, milestones, budget. Selected teams get a grant, paid as each
milestone lands.

choice.title: Go to RFPs if…
statements:
You're an expert dev team with a
track record of building protocols.

You want to learn the Logos
ecosystem and one day run a
product or business on it.

You want funding while you build
that expertise.

programmes.name: {mark}Prize
programmes.intro: Launch a product. Find real users. Win the prize.
programmes.body:
{mark}Prize rewards products that launch on the Logos stack and find real users. There is
no application process. Develop in public and release early so usage grows as you
build. Each prize sets its own success criteria and adoption target. Evaluators then
confirm the product runs and the usage is real. First one to meet all the criteria wins
that prize, awarded in USDT.

doesn't host or operate it.

items.title: Real support
items.body:
Office hours, livestreams and direct access to the

statement.title:
Logos doesn't
build the apps.
You do.
statement.body:
The Logos stack is open source, delivering private-by-
default blockchain, storage, and messaging. What runs
on it is up to builders.

Every mature network has wallets, exchanges, lending
markets, and multisigs. A network with end-to-end
privacy needs them too. These programmes support
builders through grants and prizes.

RFPs provide grants to support protocols and
infrastructure on Logos. {mark}Prizes reward builds that
meet the published prize criteria.
